prompt:
**Data & Privacy:**
The architecture must be entirely no-account. Store all data locally in SQLite. Provide a seamless way to backup and export data in open formats: OPML, JSON backups, HTML bookmarks, and Markdown for individual articles and highlights. Put any required generic configuration in `.env` and ship a `.env.example`.

**Robustness:**
Include clear, beautiful empty states, skeleton loaders, and graceful error handling (e.g., if a page cannot be parsed, save it as a simple bookmark). Write focused unit tests for the HTML extraction logic and at least one end-to-end happy path test covering URL saving, tagging, and highlighting. Include a comprehensive README detailing setup, data location, and backup procedures. Finish by running the tests and detailing the exact setup commands.
